answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared atlas of verified identities before it can act. The stake is tied to one hardware-bound kernel key, so one machine yields one credential, and duplicate signings slash the deposit. Honest work earns back the stake plus a share of the nectar, the epoch emission pool, while a Sybil swarm must fund a thousand separate stakes and keys, making fake identities far more expensive than the rewards they could harvest.
